entries.fcf138f2fa52149e: It is a business that publishes the free local information newspaper "Townnews," which is distributed without subscription fees, and sells advertising space in the paper. On a local-administrative-district basis, it publishes 35 editions covering 35 areas, with different content, across Kanagawa Prefecture as a whole and in Machida, Hachioji and Tama cities in Tokyo (as of end of June 2026). The paper carries everyday local information such as politics, economy, society, culture and sports, and it also publishes planned features and special issues. Advertising space is sold both directly to advertisers and through advertising agencies. Printing of the paper is outsourced to printing companies, and distribution is by inserting it into daily newspapers. As it is a single segment, revenue from this business alone is not disclosed.
